DHAKA, May 19 (Xinhua) -- Bangladeshi State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Nasrul Hamid Thursday said the government plans to keep energy prices on par with international rates.

Speaking at a program in Dhaka, he said they are working to make a guideline about fixing the price of electricity and gas by the international market.

The minister said subsidies given by the government in these two sectors will not be given in future.
